references.text: Moses wrote down this song the same day and taught it to the Israelites as preparation for presenting it to the people.
Moses spoke the words of this song to the entire assembly of Israel, providing direct context for this verse.
The actual song that Moses presented to the people, known as the Song of Moses mentioned in this verse.
Hoshea, son of Nun, was given the name Joshua by Moses. Here in Deuteronomy 32:44, his original name Hoshea is used.
Joshua (Hoshea) is first mentioned as Moses' servant and assistant, the same person standing with Moses here.
Joshua, son of Nun, was appointed as Moses' successor and was present when the song was presented to the people.
Joshua, son of Nun, who served as Moses' attendant and is called Hoshea here, took over leadership after Moses' death.
